name: lim3 array subclass through annotated binding
source: class MyArr extends Array<number> { tag: string; constructor(n: number) { super(); this.tag = n as any; } } function show(a: MyArr): void { console.log(a); } function main(): void { const a = new MyArr(3); a.push(1); const b: MyArr = a; console.log(b === a, b.length, b[0]); b.push(7); console.log(a.length); show(a); }
